meaning: to deal with, handle; to make do

senses.en: to deal with, handle; to make do

note: Informal. 对付 a person or problem; 对付一顿 = make do with a meal.

examples.zh: 这个孩子很调皮，我真不知道怎么对付他。
examples.en: This child is naughty, and I really don't know how to deal with him.

examples.zh: 冰箱里没什么菜，先对付一顿吧。
examples.en: There's hardly any food in the fridge; let's make do with a meal.

examples.zh: 你有办法对付这个问题吗？
examples.en: Do you have a way to deal with this problem?

meaning: not; 非……不可 = must, have to

senses.en: not; 非……不可 = must, have to

note: Mostly in 非……不可 or 非得. Colloquial: 你非去不可 = you must go.

examples.zh: 他非要自己去。
examples.en: He insists on going himself.

examples.zh: 他非要买那个贵的手机。
examples.en: He insists on buying that expensive phone.

examples.zh: 你为什么非要今天去？
examples.en: Why must you go today?

meaning: to weave, compile; to make up (a story)

senses.en: to weave, compile; to make up (a story)

note: 编故事 / 编一个理由 = make up a story or excuse; 编辑 = editor.

examples.zh: 别编理由了，我不想听。
examples.en: Stop making up excuses; I don't want to hear it.

examples.zh: 妈妈给孩子编了一个小故事。
examples.en: Mom made up a little story for the child.

examples.zh: 这本书是几位老师一起编的。
examples.en: This book was compiled by several teachers together.

note: More formal than 参加; focus on being involved in a process or activity.

examples.zh: 我们希望大家都能参与这个活动。
examples.en: We hope everyone can take part in this activity.

examples.zh: 他没有参与这次讨论。
examples.en: He did not take part in this discussion.

examples.zh: 孩子参与家务，对成长有好处。
examples.en: Children taking part in housework is good for their growth.

meaning: to do one's best, try one's utmost

senses.en: to do one's best, try one's utmost

note: 尽力 + verb: 尽力帮忙; 我会尽力的 = I'll do my best.

examples.zh: 我会尽力帮你的。
examples.en: I'll do my best to help you.

examples.zh: 比赛的时候，大家都在尽力。
examples.en: During the match, everyone was giving it their all.

examples.zh: 你已经尽力了，别难过。
examples.en: You've done your best, so don't feel bad.

note: As a title after the name: 王教授. The verb "to teach" is a different, formal use.

examples.zh: 这位教授在大学教经济。
examples.en: This professor teaches economics at the university.

examples.zh: 我想请教授帮我看看论文。
examples.en: I'd like to ask the professor to look over my paper.

examples.zh: 他的爸爸是大学的教授。
examples.en: His father is a university professor.

meaning: to send by mail or post; to entrust

senses.en: to send by mail or post; to entrust

note: 寄信, 寄快递, 寄包裹; 寄 something to someone: 寄给我.

examples.zh: 我要去邮局寄一个包裹。
examples.en: I'm going to the post office to send a parcel.

examples.zh: 请把文件寄给我，地址在邮件里。
examples.en: Please mail the documents to me; the address is in the email.

examples.zh: 这封信寄到北京要几天？
examples.en: How many days does it take for this letter to get to Beijing?

note: Usually in questions or negatives: 我不在乎, 你在乎吗？ Stronger than 关心 about attitude.

examples.zh: 他很在乎你的看法。
examples.en: He cares a lot about your opinion.

examples.zh: 你最在乎什么？
examples.en: What do you care about most?

examples.zh: 我不在乎输还是赢，只想开心。
examples.en: I don't care whether I lose or win; I just want to have fun.

note: Describes both things and one's feeling: 这个电影太无聊了; 我很无聊.

examples.zh: 周末一个人在家，我觉得很无聊。
examples.en: Alone at home at the weekend, I feel very bored.

examples.zh: 这个会议太无聊了，我都想睡觉了。
examples.en: This meeting is so boring that I feel like sleeping.

examples.zh: 你为什么总说这些无聊的话？
examples.en: Why do you keep saying these silly things?

note: 像……似的: 他高兴得像孩子似的. Sentence-final, sounds light and casual.

examples.zh: 他高兴得像个孩子似的。
examples.en: He is as happy as a child.

examples.zh: 她的手冰似的，你摸摸。
examples.en: Her hands are like ice; feel them.

examples.zh: 今天热得像夏天似的。
examples.en: It's as hot today as if it were summer.

note: 战斗 is military or game-like fighting; figurative: 战斗到最后.

examples.zh: 这场战斗一直打到晚上。
examples.en: This battle lasted until the evening.

examples.zh: 医生每天都在和病战斗。
examples.en: Doctors fight illness every day.

examples.zh: 小朋友都喜欢这个战斗游戏。
examples.en: All the kids like this battle game.

note: 我好烦 = I'm so annoyed; 别烦我 = don't bother me; 麻烦 is "trouble".

examples.zh: 我今天心情很烦，不想说话。
examples.en: I'm in a bad mood today and don't feel like talking.

examples.zh: 别烦我，我在工作。
examples.en: Don't bother me; I'm working.

examples.zh: 这么吵，真让人烦。
examples.en: It's so noisy; it's really annoying.

note: 做项目, 项目经理 (project manager), 研究项目. Common in work settings.

examples.zh: 我们公司正在做一个新项目。
examples.en: Our company is working on a new project.

examples.zh: 这个项目需要三个月完成。
examples.en: This project needs three months to complete.

examples.zh: 你想参加哪个项目？
examples.en: Which project do you want to join?

note: In chat, 表情 also means emoji or stickers: 发个表情.

examples.zh: 看他的表情，我就知道他不高兴。
examples.en: From his expression I knew he wasn't happy.

examples.zh: 她脸上的表情很奇怪。
examples.en: The expression on her face is odd.

examples.zh: 你发个表情给我吧。
examples.en: Send me a sticker.

note: Shows surprise: 他竟然忘了; 竟然 comes before the verb.

examples.zh: 他竟然忘了今天是我的生日。
examples.en: He actually forgot today is my birthday.

examples.zh: 这么重要的事，你竟然不告诉我？
examples.en: Such an important thing, and you didn't even tell me?

examples.zh: 我竟然在机场遇到了老师。
examples.en: To my surprise, I ran into my teacher at the airport.

note: Mostly in compounds: 外交官, 警官, 法官, 官员. Rare alone.

examples.zh: 他爸爸是一位外交官。
examples.en: His father is a diplomat.

examples.zh: 他不想当官，只想做医生。
examples.en: He doesn't want to be an official; he just wants to be a doctor.

examples.zh: 他想当法官，所以很努力学习。
examples.en: He wants to become a judge, so he studies very hard.

note: 轻松 describes a mood or a task: 工作很轻松; 轻松一下 = relax a bit.

examples.zh: 这份工作很轻松，压力不大。
examples.en: This job is easy and low-pressure.

examples.zh: 考试结束了，终于可以轻松了。
examples.en: The exam is over; at last we can relax.

examples.zh: 别紧张，放轻松。
examples.en: Don't be nervous; relax.

meaning: calm, peaceful; to install; to set (a mind) at ease

senses.en: calm, peaceful; to install; to set (a mind) at ease

note: In 平安, 安全, 安心 (put one's mind at ease); 安 + 装 = install.

examples.zh: 你放心，我会平安回家的。
examples.en: Don't worry; I'll get home safe and sound.

examples.zh: 听到她没问题，我才安心。
examples.en: Only when I heard she was fine did I feel at ease.

examples.zh: 我们想在家里安一个空调。
examples.en: We want to install an air conditioner at home.

note: 期待 + noun/verb: 期待你的回信, 期待见面. Warmer in emails.

examples.zh: 我很期待下个月的旅行。
examples.en: I'm really looking forward to next month's trip.

examples.zh: 期待在北京见到你。
examples.en: Looking forward to seeing you in Beijing.

examples.zh: 大家都期待这部电影很久了。
examples.en: Everyone has been looking forward to this film for a long time.

note: Friendly or familiar form for a young man; older people say it to youngsters.

examples.zh: 这个小伙子很努力，工作也很认真。
examples.en: This young guy is very hardworking and careful in his work.

examples.zh: 小伙子，你能帮我拿一下行李吗？
examples.en: Young man, could you help me carry my luggage?

examples.zh: 他是一个年轻的小伙子，刚工作不久。
examples.en: He's a young guy who only recently started working.
